_about: Verified Spokane-area tech employers, researched from public sources 2026-09-13, extended 2026-10-02. Every row carries the source it was taken from. Nothing here is inferred or invented: a field that could not be sourced is null, and null is the correct value to ship rather than a plausible guess. Coordinates come from the Mapbox Geocoding API applied to the sourced street address.
_pending: headcount and founded are sourced where a public filing or the company's own site states them, and null otherwise. Do not fill them in from an aggregator. stage is set only where a funding round is reported by the company or credible press (cited in note).
_excluded: Researched 2026-10-02 and left out: Vega Cloud (entered receivership in 2026, GeekWire), Servatron (closing at end of 2026, Spokane Journal), Triumph Composite Systems (Spokane plant wound down and sold), Verint ex-Next IT (no citable current Spokane office), Paw Print Genetics (acquired by Neogen; brand merging into Orivet), RiskLens (acquired by Safe Security; no citable Spokane office), Omniscia AI (Colbert, outside the district vocabulary), Govstream.ai (Seattle-based per GovTech). The closed and acquired ones are in history.json.

companies.name: Avista
companies.what: Investor-owned energy utility; runs a substantial in-house engineering and grid-technology organisation.

companies.name: IntelliTect
companies.what: Software architecture and development consultancy; custom development, data and AI, cloud and integration.

companies.name: Nuvodia
companies.what: Managed IT, cybersecurity and cloud services, with a healthcare and radiology imaging specialism.

companies.name: Commerce Architects
companies.what: Ecommerce software development: application development, cloud modernisation and commerce platform work. B Corp.

companies.name: Spiceology

companies.name: Gravity Jack
companies.what: Software studio building augmented reality, virtual reality and mobile applications; holds several AR-related patents.
companies.note: Publishes no street address. Says it moved from Liberty Lake to downtown Spokane (Holley Mason Building) in 2018. Coordinates are the Spokane city centroid.

companies.name: Two Barrels
companies.what: Software development and marketing company; the tech and marketing arm of a business-formation and website-services group, with satellite offices in Austin and West Jordan, Utah.

companies.name: Treasury4
companies.what: Cloud platform for corporate treasury teams: cash management, payments, debt, foreign exchange and entity data. Founded in 2020 by former Itron executives.
companies.note: Wonder Building, per the Spokane Journal of Business. Raised about $20M through a Series A (2023). Zip derived from the sourced street address.

companies.name: OpenEye
companies.what: Cloud-managed video surveillance software and hardware, including AI video analytics. Founded in 1999 by Rick Sheppard while a Gonzaga student; a subsidiary of Alarm.com since 2019.
companies.note: Parent trades as ALRM; OpenEye itself is not listed. Hiring through Greenhouse.

companies.name: Wagstaff
companies.what: Family-owned engineering and manufacturing company that designs and builds direct-chill casting equipment used by aluminum producers worldwide.

companies.name: Pearson Packaging Systems
companies.what: Designs, builds and services secondary packaging automation: case erectors, sealers, packers and robotic palletizing systems.
companies.note: West Plains. Address and founding year from the company's own about page.

companies.name: Gestalt Diagnostics
companies.what: Digital pathology software spun out of Inland Imaging in 2017. Its PathFlow platform handles image management, case management and AI-assisted analysis for pathology labs.
companies.note: Address from the company's contact page; 2025 press placed it at 850 E Spokane Falls Blvd, so it may have moved. Raised a $7.5M Series A in 2025.

companies.name: 14Four
companies.what: Digital production agency building games, websites, AR experiences, 3D animation and AI-integrated products for national brands. Sister company of Seven2.

companies.name: Seven2
companies.what: Digital creative agency doing online advertising, video production and web development for national clients. Shares a building with sister agency 14Four.

companies.name: Amphenol Network Solutions

companies.name: Accra-Fab
companies.what: Contract manufacturer doing precision sheet metal fabrication, machining, welding, finishing and assembly for aerospace, communications, medical and energy customers.

companies.what: Family-owned precision CNC machining shop: milling, turning, laser welding, engraving and assembly for medical device, aerospace, military and electronics customers.

companies.name: TierPoint

companies.name: Limelyte Technology Group
companies.what: Custom software development for mid-size and enterprise clients: business tools, title-industry software, mobile apps, AWS hosting and legacy modernization.

companies.name: Berg Companies

companies.name: CarbonQuest

companies.note: Street address from the Spokane Journal of Business; zip from the Census geocoder match. About $56M of Series A funding across 2024-25.

companies.name: Medcurity
companies.what: HIPAA compliance software for healthcare organizations: security risk analyses, vulnerability assessments, policy management and training.

companies.name: Impact Laboratories
companies.what: Commercial arm of the nonprofit My Green Lab: third-party verification and software for the My Green Lab sustainability certification used by labs worldwide.
companies.note: No street address published; the company was remote and said it planned a Spokane HQ. Coordinates are the Spokane city centroid. $4.95M Series A led by Spokane Angel Alliance (2025).

companies.name: BuyWander
companies.what: Online auction marketplace reselling truckloads of retail returns through daily no-reserve local auctions, using AI-assisted scanning and sorting. Founded in Spokane Valley by Jordan Allen and Brock Kowalchuk.
companies.note: HQ moved to Kent, WA in 2026; about 65 of its people remain in the Spokane area and this location still operates.

companies.name: Litehouse Health

companies.note: No street address published; a largely remote Spokane-based team. Coordinates are the Spokane city centroid.

companies.name: Blaze Barrier

companies.note: No street address published; press says Spokane-based with manufacturing on the West Plains. Coordinates are the Spokane city centroid.
